alternate_proof_routes: The paper uses a recurrence proof of scalar kernels and quantum ranks, and a separating orthogonal witness for logical nontriviality. Earlier exploratory polynomial/carry derivations prove the same claims but are not additional manuscript proofs. Slice counts are counted directly; no general gauge-orbit theorem is asserted.
independent_finite_checks: The q=2 theorem is a specialization of the all-q Lean family. C++ exhaustive enumeration and Python consumers are independently implemented checks; their software algorithms are not claimed formally verified.
